missing_claims.claim: The ordered TSA-seq indexed adapter oligo, its supplier, and the selected six-base index remain unidentified
missing_claims.evidence: Both article versions report only indexed adapters with six-base barcodes. The KAPA kit manual explicitly excludes adapters. The publisher supplement contains experimental conditions and result data, and two independent checks find that the preprint supplement lists analysis datasets.

conclusion: TSA-seq source-printed end repair, dA tailing, indexed-adapter ligation and PCR are represented. Exact ordered adapter and selected six-base index remain unresolved; no absence claim is accepted because their source identity is still unknown.
